name: Majokko de' Go♪Go♪ ~Pole to Mira☆cle Daisakusen~
original_name: 魔女っこ de’GO♪GO♪～ポールとミラ☆クル大作戦～
source:
Main character is a normal student with one special ability to see heart marks whenever situations can lead to love. After he confesses to a classmate with a heart mark, time stops and two girls jump out of the alternative dimension. They say that these dimensions are linked, and they need to supervise protagonist with the power to move love between the worlds.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-march-2004-remember11-age.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名普通學生，只有一種特殊能力：每當某種情形可能發展成戀情時，他就會看見愛心記號。他向一名身上出現愛心記號的同班同學告白後，時間突然靜止，兩名少女從另一個次元跳了出來。她們說，這些次元彼此相連，而主角擁有在不同世界之間轉移愛情的力量，因此她們必須在旁監督他。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-march-2004-remember11-age.html]vndbreview[/url]]
